newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cologne police find body parts on banks of Rhine.
newsitem.headline: Cologne police find body parts on banks of Rhine.

text.p: Police in the western German town of Cologne said on Thursday they had found parts of a male corpse strewn along the banks of the River Rhine.
The find comes three months after the discovery of three bin-bags containing severed human limbs in a Cologne suburb.

Speculation at the time linked the find to a suspected serial killer in neighbouring Belgium, where bin-bags containing body parts were also found in the southern city of Mons. German police however said there was no link.
Cologne police said they could not identify the new corpse from the limbs found, which included an arm, shoulder and a leg.
They said there were as yet no indications of foul play and that the man's death could have resulted from an accident.
